name: leaves-decay
comment: BlockLeaves decay (BlockLeaves.java:37-171, BlockLog.java:23-42): two log-and-leaves trees built silently on a stone platform (logs overwrite leaves, so BlockLeaves.onBlockRemoval already marks some leaves at t=0); tree A's trunk is removed top down at t=10, BlockLog.onBlockRemoval marks every leaf within 4 (bit 3), and random ticks run the decay search: leaves with no log within 4 steps through leaves decay (one in 20 drops a sapling item), the rest are unmarked. Tree B's leaves within range are marked and keep their log. block_box of both trees every 50, rng_state every tick, entity_state of the first drops every 100.
